notes.scope: Aave V3 Ethereum Core borrowers (debt > 0) whose dominant collateral (largest USD among collateral-enabled aToken balances) is USDC. Candidates = unique onBehalfOf of Pool Supply events with reserve in {USDC} (HyperSync, blocks 24764855..26060867), pre-filtered by getUserConfiguration (borrowing any reserve AND a target enabled as collateral). Holders who only received the aToken by transfer are not covered. Candidate window limited to the last 1296000 blocks (~180 days, from block 24764853) because the full Supply history is very large; positions whose owner has not supplied USDC in that window are missed.
notes.selfDebtFilter: Excluded 241 USDC-dominant positions (debt $9,443,149, collateral $19,276,106) whose USDC debt is >= 10% of their total debt: Kaskad shocks the collateral price with debt fixed in USD, but a USDC depeg would move both sides of such a loop. Nothing else is subtracted (other stablecoin debt stays).
notes.syntheticId: collateralId is the synthetic Kaskad id 13 ("USDC on Ethereum") for every position; the real Aave Ethereum reserve index is ethReserveId (3). debtByAsset keys are Ethereum reserve indices (see ethReserves).
notes.cap: Kept the top 300 of 507 USDC-dominant positions by debtUsd; dropped 207. Kept positions hold 100.00% of the USDC-dominant debt ($26,850,843 of $26,851,897).
notes.hfModel: hfModel = (collateralUsd + otherCollateralUsd) * ltBps / 1e4 / debtUsd, i.e. the dominant collateral's LT applied to ALL collateral (MVP approximation). hfOnchain = Pool.getUserAccountData.healthFactor / 1e18.
notes.ltRule: ltBps/bonusBps: eMode category values if user eMode > 0 and dominant asset is in the category collateralBitmap (aave-v3-origin GenericLogic/LiquidationLogic), else reserve values. bonusBps is the extra part (10400 -> 400). See totals.ltBreakdown.
notes.totals: totals.collateralUsd/debtUsd are over the kept positions (collateralUsd includes otherCollateralUsd; byAsset collateralUsd = dominant collateral only). totals.reserveSuppliedUsd = USDC aToken totalSupply on Aave Ethereum Core (all suppliers); reserveDebtUsd = 0 (not used by the consumer). totals.all* = before the cap.
notes.depth: depth = Ethereum DEX exit liquidity for USDC (GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd sum, TVL proxy) with DefiLlama cross-check, same format as data/depth.json entries.

depth.note: Sum of GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd over 20 Ethereum DEX pool(s) (page 1 = top pools by GeckoTerminal ranking); largest: DAI / USDC / USDT on curve ($161,334,992). TVL proxy (both sides of each pool), not a slippage curve. Primary USDC redemption goes through Circle (institutional accounts, not instant for a liquidator), so the immediate exit is the DEX market. DefiLlama (yields.llama.fi) Ethereum DEX pools containing USDC: 478 pools, $1,181,906,959 total; top: curve-dex DAI-USDC-USDT $161,237,591; uniswap-v3 USDC-WETH $99,357,312 (0.05%); uniswap-v4 BMD-USDC $97,046,575 (0.01%); curve-dex USDC-RLUSD $59,713,377; uniswap-v4 ETH-USDC $44,721,773 (0.30%); uniswap-v3 USDC-WETH $42,478,643 (0.3%); fluid-dex USDC-USDT $34,608,142; uniswap-v3 USDC-USDT $34,325,387 (0.01%). Non-DEX venues using it (lending / Pendle / vaults; not spot exit liquidity): maple $2,920,664,385; spark-savings $305,194,675; re $272,279,226; aave-v3 $201,316,424; pareto-credit $155,286,444; fluid-lending $130,015,185.
